name: Yamabito Stone Prayer
loreTies: Sacred Balance: careful positioning unlocks spirit precision effects.
Yamabito Stone Prayer is a colossal Kami Titan shaped by balance is defended by precision. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Yamabito Stone Prayer is a Kami Assassin whose Gate scar links The Sacred Kingdoms to The First Reopening; their power expresses balance is defended by precision under campaign pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Yamabito Stone Prayer began as more than a weapon in The Sacred Kingdoms. Yamabito Stone Prayer was bound to a shrine path folded by spirit wind during a Gate disturbance that tested whether balance is defended by precision could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Titan chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Kami, Yamabito Stone Prayer is treated as proof that a spiritual civilization of sacred duty, ancestral power, shrine law, discipline, nature spirits, and divine balance can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries lacquered armor, steel, sacred markings, masks, shrine-light, ink, mist, spirit ribbons, but their real identity is tactical: precise control, repositioning, evasion, spirit terrain, disciplined burst. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Yamabito Stone Prayer; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Titan to overextend, break formation, or turn culture into raw fuel. Yamabito Stone Prayer survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever precision terrain appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In The First Reopening, Yamabito Stone Prayer gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a 5-Titan squad, Yamabito Stone Prayer turns Sacred Balance from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Yamabito Stone Prayer's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 40, attack 10, range 1, speed 3, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
